labels.label: bzprop:c3s5p2_support_appui
labels.notes: isVarieteAppui_affineSpan_of_proprieteI: Convex W, V.Nonempty, ProprieteI V W (= V ⊆ W ∧ Convex V ∧ Convex (W \ V), Déf. 1 verbatim) ⊢ IsVarieteAppui W (affineSpan ℝ V). Any real vector space, no finite dimension: matches l.1183-1186 exactly. 'variété linéaire engendrée' = affineSpan is the standard reading. The REPORT's observation that the proof's first step needs no topology is a remark on the proof, not a claimed error; it is correct (exists_extend_mem_of_mem_affineSpan is kernel-checked).

labels.label: bzprop:c3s5p3_complementaire_appui
labels.notes: complementaire_appui gives both sentences: Convex (W ∩ Lᶜ) and, for every convex C ⊆ L ∩ W, Convex ((W ∩ Lᶜ) ∪ C). Convex W is carried as the setting: Déf. 3 (l.186-189) defines variétés d'appui of 'le convexe W' of § 1, and the α-reformulation used in the printed proof (l.191-192) already needs convexity. Disclosed in SCOPE and REPORT questions; legitimate. Instance carre_moins_lineY0_union_origine uses a nonempty C = {(0,0)} and the real variété d'appui lineY0 of the square: non-vacuous.

labels.label: bzprop:c3s5p4_propriete_I_appui
labels.notes: proprieteI_iff_isVarieteAppui: Convex W, Convex V, V ⊆ W, V.Nonempty ⊢ ProprieteI V W ↔ IsVarieteAppui W (affineSpan ℝ V) ∧ ProprieteI V (affineSpan ℝ V ∩ W). Exactly l.1217-1219 with « support L de V » = affineSpan ℝ V (disclosed; consistent with Facettes/Appui). Unused hypotheses _hV, _hVW are the printed ones, harmless. The ⇐ half proprieteI_of_isVarieteAppui is stronger (drops non-emptiness). Prop. 1's printed precise form (OQ-162) is not used: the module imports ProprieteI only for Déf. 1 and the square instance; no reference to the Prop. 1 statements. Instance bordCarre_appui_proprieteI is a real consequence on the square's edge.
